name: apple-reminders
description: Turn meeting notes, screenshots, and plans into organized Apple Reminders from Codex on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Turn notes and screenshots into Apple Reminders
interface.longDescription: Turn meeting notes and screenshots into structured Apple Reminders, create items in exact lists, and review overdue or upcoming work. Core runs locally on macOS 14+ without Xcode and uses exact read-backs for successful writes. Tag assignments and native URL attachments avoid compilation but remain version-sensitive private-store features. Section writes, image-attachment changes, and exact Recently Deleted inspection or recovery require Xcode Command Line Tools. Changes may sync through Apple accounts and shared lists; there is no plugin-owned remote backend.
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into one reminder per action item, preserving owners and deadlines, then add them to my Work list
Create one Apple Reminder per screenshot in my Applications list, preserving any dates and useful details
Brief me on everything overdue, due today, and coming up this week
